paragraph: I remember seeing her **once** on the street. I suggested that he go there at **once**. You are to see a doctor at **once**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أذكر أني لمحتها مرة على الطريق.

paragraph: Please **add** my name to the list. I'll **add** that to my wish list. Don't forget to **add** me in.
english: to append (e.g. a statement); to say further information; to add on
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك أضف اسمي إلى اللائحة.

other.meaning: to perform the arithmetical operation of addition, to add up

paragraph: One is red and the other is **white**. Miss **White** is liked by everyone. She wore a **white** dress.
english: of or relating to Caucasians — see also Caucasian
arabicDesc: مثال: واحدة حمراء والأخرى بيضاء.

other.meaning: The color of snow or milk (noun)

paragraph: Many students like to **study** in the morning. That's the reason they want to **study** English. What do you **study** a foreign language for?
arabicDesc: مثال: العديد من الطلبة يحبون الدراسة صباحا.

other.meaning: Mental effort to acquire knowledge or learning (noun)

paragraph: She was a British **national**. They held almost no power at the **national** level. People get lost in the **national** park every day.
english: pertaining to a nation or country; the state
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت مواطنية بريطانيّة.

paragraph: You must not come to **meet** me again. I would like you to **meet** my parents. I'm sorry that I can't **meet** you tonight.
english: to come face to face with by accident; to encounter
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تأتي لزيارتي مرة أخرى.

other.meaning: to come face to face with someone by arrangement

paragraph: He was listening to **music** in his room. We are listening to **music**, and you? Could you turn the **music** down?
english: sound, organized in time in a melodious way
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يستمع إلى الموسيقى في غرفته.

paragraph: We're sorry but this **video** is no longer available. I've watched that **video** three times. The **video** has been removed.
arabicDesc: مثال: نأسف, ولكن هذا الفيديو ليس متاحاً.

paragraph: Some things are in our **control** and others not. Guys want to be in **control** all the time. Didn't I tell you I had it under **control**?
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مراقبة، سيطرة

paragraph: They have three **young** children of their own. Are there **young** people who speak your language? You are **young**. I, on the other hand, am very old.
english: in the early part of life or growth
arabicDesc: مثال: لديهم ثلاثة أطفال صغار

paragraph: It is better for you to **act** by legal means. I tried to **act** natural. They **acted** like they weren't there.
english: to behave in a certain way
arabicDesc: مثال: من الأحسن لك أن تسير على الطرق القانونية.

paragraph: I asked him to **send** us the book. Where did she **send** him? Please **send** us more information.
arabicDesc: مثال: طلبت منه أن يبعث الكتاب إلينا.

paragraph: The party split into two **warring** factions.
english: a particular conflict of this kind

other.meaning: To engage in conflict (may be followed by "with" to specify the foe) (verb)

paragraph: As **far** as I know, he was a good student. How **far** is it from your house to the park? A police car was parked not too **far** from us.
arabicDesc: مثال: حسب علمي، كان طالبا جيدا.

paragraph: Attack is the best **form** of defense. Please help me fill out this **form**. Fill out the application **form**.
arabicDesc: مثال: الهجوم خير وسيلة للدفاع.

other.meaning: To assume (a certain shape or visible structure) (verb)

paragraph: Will you **record** this program on video for me? Would you like to state something for the **record**? She told me that she has bought a **record**.
english: information put into a lasting physical medium
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مدونة، تدوين، قيد

other.meaning: most extreme known value of some achievement
Enough to break previous records and set a new one (adjective)

paragraph: Are you going to pay a visit to China this **fall**? Why must all men **fall** in love with me? I don't want that. She **fell** in love with a younger man.
english: move to a lower position under the effect of gravity
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعتزم زيارة الصين هذا الخريف؟

other.meaning: The act of moving to a lower position under the effect of gravity (noun)

paragraph: I wish I had been **kind** to her then. I'm not used to this **kind** of work. I like to answer this **kind** of question.
arabicDesc: مثال: ليتني عاملتها بإحسان آنذاك.

paragraph: **Though** it was cold, he didn't light the fire. Even **though** he was poor, he was happy. **Though** she looks like his older sister, the fact is that she is his mother.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يشعل النار مع أن الجو كان بارداً.

paragraph: She asked him and he said **yes**. **Yes**, that happens from time to time. **Yes**, but you do not have to stay to the end.
english: word used to indicate agreement or acceptance
arabicDesc: مثال: سألَتْهُ وردّ بِنعم.

other.meaning: word used to indicate disagreement or dissent in reply to a negative statement

paragraph: It's important to me that we **follow** the rules. You have to **follow** the rules. As long as you live in my house, you'll **follow** my rules.
english: to go or come after in physical space
arabicDesc: مثال: يهمّني أن نتبع القوانين.

other.meaning: to go or come after in a sequence
to carry out in accordance to

paragraph: Did you **thank** him? Did you say **thank** you? At any rate, I would like to **thank** you all. I don't know how to **thank** you.
english: to express appreciation or gratitude toward (someone or something)
arabicDesc: مثال: هل شكرتهُ, هل قلت شكراً لك؟

paragraph: As a matter of **fact**, I have had nothing since this morning. You should make sure of the **facts** before you write something. You must face the **facts**.
arabicDesc: مثال: في الحقيقة لم آكل أي شيء منذ هذا الصباح.

paragraph: What do you **actually** do in the office? I never **actually** wanted to go there. I should **actually** not work so much.
english: in act or in fact; really; in truth; positively
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هي طبيعة عملك في المكتب؟

paragraph: All **American** bills are similar in color. I have reason to believe that the **American** side started to better understand our positions. **American** houses are big and they keep getting bigger.
arabicDesc: مثال: كل الأوراق النقدية الأمريكية لديها نفس اللون.

other.meaning: person born in, or a citizen of, the U.S. — see also U.S. American, Yankee
Of, from, or pertaining to the United States of America, its people, or its culture (adjective)

paragraph: You'll learn how to do it sooner or **later**. I may have to call you **later**. She says she will call you **later**.
arabicDesc: مثال: ستتعلم كيف تفعلها عاجلًا أو آجلًا.

paragraph: I wanted to **hit** him, but he ran away from me. I didn't really mean to **hit** you. I was nearly **hit** by a car.
english: to administer a blow — see also strike
arabicDesc: مثال: أردت أن أضربه و لكنه هرب مني.

other.meaning: to manage to touch in the right place

paragraph: There is no **reason** why I shouldn't do it. I know you're here for another **reason**. If for some **reason** that should happen, what would you do?
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يوجد سبب لئلا أفعله.

other.meaning: (the capacity of the human mind for) rational thinking

paragraph: By the way, how many **kids** are going? He took the **kids** to the school. She liked to talk about her **kids**.
arabicDesc: مثال: بالمناسبة، كم ولداً سيذهب؟

paragraph: Did you buy it on the **black** market? I have two dogs. One is white and the other **black**. That **black** one is mine.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل اشتريت ذلك من السوق السوداء؟

other.meaning: The colour/color perceived in the absence of light, but also when no light is reflected, but rather absorbed (noun)

paragraph: You can do whatever you want to do, of **course**. Of **course**, I have to tell her. If something is fun, I like to do it, of **course**.
arabicDesc: مثال: بالطبع، تستطيع ان تفعل ما تشاء.

paragraph: This computer saves a great **deal** of time. Why is this such a big **deal**? Can you **deal** with it?
english: the distribution of cards to players
arabicDesc: مثال: الحاسب الآلي يوفر قدراً كبيراً من الوقت.

paragraph: We have no options but to **continue**. Once you begin, you must **continue**. Let's stop here and **continue** tomorrow.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا خيار لنا سوى المتابعة.

paragraph: I don't want to tell them why I'm **late**. I wouldn't want you to be **late** for class. It seems to me that the train is **late**.
english: near the end of a period of time
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد أن أخبرهم عن سبب تأخّري.

other.meaning: After a deadline has passed, past a designated time (adverb)

paragraph: I wish to **stay** at a five-star hotel. They had to **stay** at home all day. I told them to **stay** in their room.
english: to remain in a particular place
arabicDesc: مثال: أتمنى أن أقيم في فندق خمس نجوم.

other.meaning: Continuance or a period of time spent in a place (noun)

paragraph: I want to get her out of my **mind**. He made up his **mind** to be a doctor. Why don't you just tell us what's on your **mind**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أتوقف من التفكير عنها.

paragraph: How is it going in the fish **market**? They put their house on the **market**. We came back from the **market**.
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف الأحوال في سوق السمك؟

paragraph: He asked the **general** to take back his order. I have a **general** idea of what he means. You gave a **general** idea of what you wanted.
english: including or involving every part or member of a given or implied entity, whole, etc

other.meaning: not limited in application; applicable to a whole class or category

paragraph: I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long **term**. This is the first time I've heard that **term**. You need to start thinking in the long-**term**.
english: word or phrase, especially one from a specialised area of knowledge
arabicDesc: مثال: أظنه يختلف حين تفكر فيه على المدى البعيد.

paragraph: How much of our **body** is water? A sound mind in a sound **body**. I would like to have a **body** like that.
english: physical structure of a human or animal
arabicDesc: مثال: كم تمثل نسبة المياه من أجسادنا؟

paragraph: I don't know if they made up after the **fight**. She got into a **fight** with her mom. Two against one is not a fair **fight**.
english: (transitive) to contend in physical conflict against
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعلم إن تصالحا بعد ذلك العراك.

other.meaning: (reciprocal) to contend in physical conflict with each other

paragraph: It will only take a **minute** of your time. It's only a 5 **minute** walk from the train station. The doctor is going to be here any **minute**.
arabicDesc: مثال: سيأخذ دقيقة من وقتك فقط.

paragraph: Do you have any **idea** who would do this? I have no **idea** what I'm supposed to do. His **idea** is beyond the reach of my understanding.
english: an image of an object that is formed in the mind or recalled by the memory
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك اي فكرة عن من يستطيع فعل هذا؟

other.meaning: any result of mental activity; a thought, a notion; a way of thinking

paragraph: He wouldn't **allow** me to drive his car. I can't **allow** you to do that. Why are we not **allowed** to do that?
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يسمح لي أن أقود سيارته إطلاقاً.

paragraph: We sat in the **center** of the room. Don't believe you are the **center** of the world! The park is in the **center** of the city.
english: point equidistant from all points on the perimeter of a circle
arabicDesc: مثال: جلسنا وسط الغرفة.

other.meaning: point equidistant from all points on the surface of a sphere

paragraph: She doesn't want me to speak about this **matter**. It doesn't **matter** whether he agrees or not. No **matter** what happens, I won't be surprised.
arabicDesc: مثال: هي لا تريدني أن أتحدث حول هذه المسألة.

paragraph: We were fined for running a red **light**. He forgot to turn off the **light**. Don't sleep with the **light** left on.
arabicDesc: مثال: دفعنا غرامة لتجاوزنا الضوء الأحمر.

other.meaning: traffic light, or an intersection controlled by one

paragraph: **Everyone** has to learn the words by heart. And actually, this project needs **everyone**. Not **everyone** in town likes us.
arabicDesc: مثال: على الجميع أن يحفظ تلك الكلمات.

paragraph: Have you ever been to the **United** States? I bought this when I was in the **United** States. These three countries were **united** into one.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سبق لك أن ذهبت إلى الولايات المتحدة؟

paragraph: The **president** is expected to put forward a new energy policy. What would the new **president** do? He made it known where the **president** had gone.
english: the head of state of a republic
arabicDesc: مثال: من المتوقع أن يطرح الرئيس سياسةً جديدةً للطاقة.

paragraph: I'll **return** the book as soon as I can. Do you know when they will **return**? You must **return** the book to him.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأُعيد الكتاب بأقرب وقت ممكن.

other.meaning: to give something back to its original holder or owner

paragraph: It's about time you did your **share** of work. You must **share** your jobs with others. I want to **share** this with you.
english: to give part of what one has to somebody else to use or consume
arabicDesc: مثال: حان الأوان كي تقوم بحصتك من العمل.

paragraph: He does not know how to **drive** a car. I still haven't learned to **drive** a car. She is learning how to **drive** a car.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه لا يعرف كيف يقود سيارة.

other.meaning: to move (something) by hitting it with great force

paragraph: How many boys are there in this **class**? At what time does your **class** end? The new teacher is in the **class**.
english: group of students in a regularly scheduled meeting with a teacher
arabicDesc: مثال: كم ولداً موجود في هذا الصف؟

other.meaning: group, collection, category or set sharing characteristics or attributes
social grouping, based on job, wealth, etc.

paragraph: Please **stand** by me when I need you. He needs to learn how to **stand** up for himself. Go and **stand** next to your car.
english: to support oneself on the feet in an erect position
arabicDesc: مثال: أرجوك قف إلی جانبي عندما أحتاجك.

paragraph: At what **age** did you have your first period? As we **age**, our ability to remember gets worse. Children begin school at the **age** of six.
english: one of the stages of life
arabicDesc: مثال: في أي سن بدأت عندك الدورة الشهرية؟

other.meaning: particular period of time in history

paragraph: She married him the **following** year. He told me he would start the **following** day. She turned around and saw someone was **following** her.
arabicDesc: مثال: تزوجته في السنة التالية

paragraph: Maybe some people just aren't meant to be **together**. His words and actions do not go **together** well. Why don't you and I do that **together**?
english: at the same time, in the same place
arabicDesc: مثال: ربّما بعض النّاس لم يُخلقوا كي يعيشوا معا.

paragraph: You must consider this problem as a **whole**. The **whole** family is out for a walk. You're the best mom in the **whole** world!
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب عليك أن تنظر في هذه المشكلة بشكلٍ كلي.

paragraph: Anything you say can be used against you in **court**. Now the ball is in your **court**! If that's your last word, see you in **court**!
english: hall, chamber, or place, where justice is administered
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكن استخدام أي شيء تقوله ضدك في المحكمة.

other.meaning: place for playing the game of tennis and some other ball games

paragraph: Where was she when I was **single**? She remained **single** all her life. Are you married or **single**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أين كانت هي حين كنت أعزبا.

paragraph: I am going to **check** the work. I just went to **check** something. Can I give him the **check**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا سوف أذهب لتفقد العمل

paragraph: I'm trying to **understand** why you didn't do it. It is good for us to **understand** other cultures. I don't **understand** Chinese, but I want to learn.
arabicDesc: مثال: أحاول أن أفهم لماذا لم تقم بالأمر.

paragraph: This **creates** a lot of political problems. Now we have to **create** one in two weeks. If this were done, it would **create** many jobs.
arabicDesc: مثال: يخلق هذا الكثير من المشاكل السياسية.

paragraph: Will you make a **list** of issues to discuss? This is a **list** of what we need. Did you discuss any of the issues on our **list**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك عمل قائمة بالمسائل التي ستناقش؟

paragraph: It's a matter of life and **death**. We received word of his **death**. Nothing is more certain than **death**.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنها مسالة حياة أو موت.

paragraph: I just wish I knew how to **speak** French. I know a man who can **speak** Russian well. I need to **speak** with you right away.
english: to communicate with one's voice using words
arabicDesc: مثال: أتمنتى فقط لو أستطعتُ تكلّمَ الفرنسيّةِ.

other.meaning: to be able to communicate in a language

paragraph: I am a **student**, but he isn't. I am a **student** of this school. The college accepted him as a **student**.
english: person enrolled at a school, university or other education institution
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا تلميذ، ولكن هو ليس بواحد.

other.meaning: person enrolled at a university — see also university student

paragraph: I think they have been married for **five** years. I've been living here for **five** years. It's because he lived in the United States for **five** years.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعتقد أنهما متزوجان منذ خمسة سنوات.

paragraph: **Maybe** you don't remember me, but I remember you. **Maybe** you could tell me where she is. **Maybe** I don't like it the way I loved you.
arabicDesc: مثال: ربما لا تتذكّرني، لكنّي أتذكرك.

paragraph: How much do you have to pay **per** month? The car hit the wall at 90 miles **per** hour. How many French classes do you have **per** week?
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بواسطة، عن طريق

other.meaning: used in expressing ratios of units

paragraph: There are a lot of books in his **room**. He had to look for his **room** by himself. Do you know any of the children in the **room**?
arabicDesc: مثال: ثمة كتب كثيرة في غرفته.

paragraph: I need you at my **office** right away. The people in the **office** will never agree. If you don't clean this **office**, you're fired.
english: room(s) or building used for non-manual work
arabicDesc: مثال: أحتاجك في مكتبي في الحين.

paragraph: So, have you thought about my **offer**? I have nothing to **offer**. I may just take you up on that **offer**.
english: to propose or express one's willingness (to do something)
arabicDesc: مثال: إذًا، هل فكّرت بعرضي لك؟

other.meaning: to present something as a gesture of worship

paragraph: That guy must have been a **local**. He was seen at a **local** bank. He was accepted to a **local** college.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا بدّ من أن ذلك الرّجل ساكن محلّي.

paragraph: Don't worry about the results of your **test**. We're going to have a **test** today. I have to study for the **test**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تقلق بشأن نتائج إختبارك.

other.meaning: To challenge, to put a strain on (something) (verb)

paragraph: Do you **remember** the day when we first met? It is important to **remember** who your friends are. Do you **remember** the town where he was born?
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تذكر اليوم الذي تقابلنا فيه أول مرة؟

paragraph: My Lord, **increase** my knowledge. Little by little our knowledge of English **increases**. The number of deaths is **increasing**.
arabicDesc: مثال: رَّبِّ زِدنِي عِلمٗا.

paragraph: Big Brother is keeping an **eye** on you. Drive me to the **eye** doctor. My sister saw it with her own **eyes**.
english: an organ through which animals see (“perceive surroundings via light”)
arabicDesc: مثال: الأخ الأكبر براقبكم.

paragraph: What would you like to be when you **grow** up? When I **grow** up, I want to be a king. Where did she **grow** up?
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا تريد أن تصبح عندما تكبر؟

paragraph: We still have a lot of **food** left. Do you have any questions about the **food**? There was **food** enough for us all.
english: any substance consumed by living organisms to sustain life
arabicDesc: مثال: ما زال لدينا الكثير من الطعام.

paragraph: The house was completely burnt down by a **fire**. Be sure to put out the **fire** before you leave. But in the end he put the book on the **fire**.
arabicDesc: مثال: البيت كان محترقاً تماماً من جراء النار.

other.meaning: To set (something, often a building) on fire (verb)

paragraph: The police got in touch with the **health** department. A walk after eating is good for **health**. It is said that smoking is bad for your **health**.
english: state of being free of physical or psychological disease, illness, or malfunction
arabicDesc: مثال: اتّصلت الشّرطة بقسم الصّحّة.

paragraph: I know how **important** she is to you. He doesn't have any idea how **important** this meeting is. We need to do the **important** things first.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعرف كم هي تهمّك.

paragraph: I know how much he **means** to you. Is this what life **means** to you? This word **means** a lot to her.
english: a way of doing or achieving something
arabicDesc: مثال: أعرفُ كَم يعني لكِ.

paragraph: He always listens to the **news** on the radio. Did you hear the **news** on the radio? The good **news** is that we'll be able to help you.
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يستمع دائما للأخبار بالمذياع.

paragraph: We are able to deliver **within** a week. She will be back **within** a week. Police were on the scene **within** minutes.
english: in the scope or range of
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكاننا تسليم المنتوج في أسبوع.

paragraph: Let's **consider** the worst that could happen. I **consider** him a friend. You'll **consider** this, won't you?
arabicDesc: مثال: لِنُفَكّر بأسوأ ما يمكن أن يكون قد حصل.

paragraph: This **event** benefits no one. I have no idea where the **event** will be. I didn't know what to do after that **event**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الحادث لا يفيد أحداً.

paragraph: I like this **design** more than the other one. The project didn't make it past the **design** stage. Let's keep our **design** dark for a short time.
english: a specification of an object or process, referring to requirements to be satisfied and thus conditions to be met for them to solve a problem
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تخطيط

paragraph: We were concerned for the **community**. He did it for the good of the **community**. We consider you all a part of the **community**.
arabicDesc: مثال: كنّا قليقين بشأن البلدة.

paragraph: Our **date** is not over yet. I'll never forget our first **date**. What is the **date** today?
arabicDesc: مثال: لم ينتهي موعدنا بعد.

other.meaning: To note the time or place of writing or executing (verb)

paragraph: But did you **receive** the messages? He came to that which was his own, but his own did not **receive** him. We haven't **received** any help from anyone.
arabicDesc: مثال: ولكن هل إستلمت الرسالة؟

other.meaning: to take what is offered, accept from another
to act as a host for guests

paragraph: How much does your phone **cost**? It was well worth the **cost**. Why does it **cost** so much to do this?
english: to incur a charge of; to require payment of a price of
arabicDesc: مثال: كم سعر هاتفك ؟

other.meaning: Amount of money (or time, etc.) that is required or used (noun)

paragraph: I'm going to **release** you. You must take action for their early **release**. She broke through after the **release** of her third single.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأطلق سراحك.

paragraph: I don't think you'll be **able** to do that. I'll never be **able** to love you again. I want to be **able** to read French.
english: having the necessary powers or the needed resources to accomplish a task
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أظنك قادرا على فعل ذلك.

paragraph: What sort of **information** do you get on the Internet? Thank you for the **information**. When we lose a language we lose **information** about culture, society and history.
arabicDesc: مثال: أيَّ نوع من المعلومات تجد في الإنترنت؟

paragraph: **Oh**, I'm late. I should be going now. **Oh** no! Have you fallen in love with me? **Oh**, what have I done? What have I done?
arabicDesc: مثال: آه، لقد تأخرت، علي أن أذهب الآن.

paragraph: **Thanks** to him, I could get a job. Hi! **Thanks** for flying with us. How are you today? I don't know how to express my **thanks**.
english: used to express appreciation or gratitude
arabicDesc: مثال: بفضله، تمكنت من الحصول على وظيفة.

paragraph: Not more than 40 percent of students go on **university**. This was how he entered the **university**. I'm a student in a **university**.
english: a place of higher education where people study for degrees
arabicDesc: مثال: اقل من 40% من الطلبة فقط يذهبون الى الجامعة.
